mapper.select: SELECT plan_code FROM account_plan WHERE account_id = #{accountId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO plan_usage_counter (account_id, feature, period_key, used_count, updated_at) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{feature}, #{periodKey}, 0, #{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE used_count = used_count
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM saved_support_program saved INNER JOIN support_program program ON program.id = saved.support_program_id WHERE saved.account_id = #{accountId} AND program.is_source_present = TRUE
